Grounded claims

S-1

Nightly full rebuilds were replaced by incremental indexing with no change to the public query contract.

S-2

Checkpoints are partition-local, index writes are idempotent, and the full rebuild survives as a recovery path.

S-3

A checkpointed change reader feeds idempotent workers, and a scheduled audit samples both sides for drift.
